steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Equation of a circle: A circle with centre (0, 0) and radius r has equation: x² + y² = r² | General form: For a circle with centre (a, b) and radius r: (x - a)² + (y - b)² = r²

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write the equation of a circle with centre (0, 0) and radius 7. | Find the radius of x² + y² = 36. | Does (5, 12) lie on x² + y² = 169?
